Images and links

Images

or Insert › Image inserts an image from the computer at the place of the selection.

ActionEffect
drag the imagemoves it
drag a handleresizes it
Delete, the image being selecteddeletes it

Images are saved in the Excel file, in their place.

Links

Select a cell, right-click › Insert link.

Link typeAddress
web page (Webpages)https://…
range of cells (Cell range)Sheet1!A1:C8
Sheeta sheet of the workbook

The Display text becomes the content of the cell, blue and underlined. When the cell is selected, Open link appears under it.

Links are not saved in the Excel file: only their text is.
